answer: Locks are recorded in ivory, expire in mesa, and juniper lists each expiry. An farming party running 94 aliases hence needs 50 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4159 identities would post 1026 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
